screen: Production Connections, reconnect and error (phone 390, full page), Stage 5 pass 2

expected_differences: Demo Roastery and its business initial replace the Lab’s personal identity and portrait; the actual business name should remain unchanged.
Connections is a utility screen, so the mineral surface, compact service rows and absence of a graphite identity masthead are appropriate.
Instagram shows the stored Reconnect required state; Google shows Needs attention and the reported 403 Forbidden message rather than invented connection health.
Reconnect controls are disabled because provider credentials are absent, with an explanation directly beneath each service.
Facebook and TikTok honestly show Not available yet without suggesting that connection is possible.
Business navigation replaces the Lab’s personal navigation, with Business correctly selected on this management route.
No portrait gallery, vehicle, earnings or source-to-commitment assembly belongs on this screen. Their absence is not drift.
A Contact support link is correctly absent while no support mailbox is configured.
keep: Mineral #F4F3EF canvas, ink headings, muted supporting copy and restrained #CFD3D1 row dividers; no floating cards or shadows.
The 16px phone gutters, strong 30/36px application title and clear service-name, status, action and explanation hierarchy.
Full-size Reconnect controls, approximately 110×48px with 8px corners, preserving comfortable touch-target geometry.
Literal status words alongside color, and the Google error’s narrow problem-colored rule rather than an oversized alert panel.
The Settings back route, account switcher, search, messages, notifications and persistent business navigation.
Cobalt concentrated on actions and the selected navigation edge rather than repeated service decoration.
review.readiness_note: Sign off this screen at 390px for the captured unconfigured-provider state. The capture supports visual and state-exposure approval; live OAuth, navigation destinations and keyboard/focus behavior still need runtime verification.
review.why: The Lab reference is a Profile screen, so fidelity here is to its approved system rather than its composition. Production carries over the mineral canvas, strong Archivo heading treatment, readable operational typography, flat separators and white navigation surface. At 390px, service names, status text, disabled actions and explanations fit without clipping; the Google error remains fully readable and the final service clears the bottom navigation. Controls retain full-size geometry despite being unavailable. Business has the selected cobalt edge and ink label. No media, money or meaningful source-to-decision boundary exists here, so adding the Profile’s imagery, financial hierarchy or 12px joint would be inappropriate. The visible states distinguish a stored provider problem from this environment’s missing configuration without claiming a successful connection or fabricated performance.
review.verdict: Frame Shift was faithfully transferred to this Connections screen, with real states and navigation preserved and no release-blocking visual drift at 390px.
